title: Toby Turtle's Little Jump
description: A reassuring tale about a slow turtle who finds his own special strength during a sudden rain shower.

scenes.narration: Toby Turtle walked slowly along the pond edge, watching the happy green frogs leap high into the air.
scenes.visual: cute green turtle slowly walking beside a calm blue pond surrounded by tall cattails

scenes.narration: He wished he could jump over tall stones and splash like his bouncy forest friends did every day.
scenes.visual: turtle looking wistfully up at a frog hopping high above a mossy rock

scenes.narration: Suddenly, dark rain clouds rolled in, and big raindrops began to fall heavily all over the meadow.
scenes.visual: rain falling gently on green lily pads and dark wet stones by the water

scenes.narration: The little frogs shivered in the cold rain, looking for a dry spot to hide from the heavy splashing drops.
scenes.visual: small cold frogs huddling together near a wet muddy stone under falling rain

scenes.narration: Toby tucked his head inside his strong shell and offered room under his back for his cold little friends.
scenes.visual: turtle holding steady while tiny frogs shelter happily under his smooth round shell

scenes.narration: The frogs stayed warm and dry until the sun came out, thanking Toby for his grand sturdy shell.
scenes.visual: sunlight breaking through leaves onto a smiling turtle surrounded by cheerful frogs

scenes.narration: Everyone has a special gift to share. Sleep warmly tonight, and follow along for more soothing bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: cute turtle resting comfortably on a warm flat stone by the peaceful moonlit pond

character_reference: A small olive-green turtle with large dark eyes and a sturdy, domed brown shell featuring light tan markings along the seams.
